name: admin.py backup-copy: copy complete backup pairs to an off-machine directory
summary: admin.py backup-copy DEST copies, under DEST, every project whose last backup pair is complete (with its task-files folder when there is one); a project that is not complete is skipped and named, and the run then exits non-zero and publishes no completeness record. --all-or-nothing copies nothing unless every initialized project has a complete pair; --require-clean also refuses a project recorded degraded.
